name: cdn-ech-outer-block
description: The shared ECH outer name cloudflare-ech.com is on the blocklist (reassembling box, RST both ways), and so is the zone's own name — a tripwire: a client that fell back to a plain hello would show it, and the censor's log would say so. Every ECH hello in one record dies. Op cdn: the CDN route's ECH hello is reset, it is NOT retried with a plain hello (owner decision D-2: no plain fallback unless the signed flag says so), and the next rung, the ECH hello split across TLS records (h:split), carries: this box joins TCP segments but not TLS records (the researched blind spot, censor_dpi.go). Against a box that joins records the route would be dead, as plan §2.1 says; the zone name never shows. The direct families are untouched.
analogue: Russia's block of cloudflare-ech.com (November 2024): one rule ends ECH to every Cloudflare site at once. Plan §2.1 lists it as what the CDN add-on does not rescue. Model: exact outer name, full reassembly. Not modelled: blocking by the ECH extension's presence rather than by name, or ECH GREASE handling.
